title: 12 Best Night Markets in Chengdu
description: Explore Chengdu's vibrant night markets! Discover the best spots for authentic Sichuan street food, bustling atmospheres, and unique local experiences in 2026.

places.name: Jianshe Road Food Street (建设路美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Li Ji Guo Kui (crispy flatbread with savory fillings), various Skewers (Chuan'r), Malatang (spicy numbing hot pot on a stick).

places.name: Jinli Ancient Street (锦里古街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order San Pao Tai (three-cannon tea), Tang You Guo Zi (sticky rice balls with brown sugar), Dan Hong Gao (sweet egg cakes), spicy rabbit head.

places.name: Xiangxiang Alley (香香巷)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any variant of Chuan Chuan Xiang, spicy hotpot, Leshan Bobo Chicken (cold skewers in chili oil).

places.name: Sichuan University Food Street (川大美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Various BBQ skewers, Malatang, Shao Kao (Chinese BBQ), fresh fruit juices, Bubble Tea.

places.name: Yulin East Road (玉林东路)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mapo Tofu (classic spicy tofu), Kung Pao Chicken, various local stir-fries, 'Dandan Mian' (spicy noodles).

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley (宽窄巷子)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chengdu San Da Pao (sticky rice balls), Long Chao Shou (wonton soup), Zong Zi (glutinous rice dumplings), various traditional teas.

places.name: Wangping Street (望平街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Craft beer, creative Sichuan fusion dishes, skewers with a modern twist, desserts from local cafes.

places.name: Wenshu Monastery Food Street (文殊院美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetarian potstickers (guotie), sweet tofu pudding (douhua), various pastries from the monastery's own bakery, herbal teas.

places.name: Zhongshulu Food Street (忠恕路美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mianyang Rice Noodles, roasted sweet potatoes, grilled oysters, various BBQ skewers.

places.name: Jiuyan Bridge Bar Street (九眼桥酒吧街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Spicy crayfish (mala xiao long xia), grilled fish, various noodle soups, 'chuan'r' (skewers).

places.name: Shishi Road Food Street (石室路美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Rou Jia Mo (Chinese 'burger'), spicy potato strings, various rice bowls (gai jiao fan), fried chicken.

places.name: Hongxing Road No. 3 Alley (红星路三段)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sweet-and-sour ribs, fried squid, Bingfen (jelly dessert), various local pastries.
